title: Welcome to Agentys
welcome_desc: Agentys will analyze your recent emails to learn your writing style and generate replies tailored to your tone.
welcome_detail: The analysis reads your recent sent emails from your provider to detect communication habits, without storing email bodies in Agentys Cloud.
step0_promise: AI that learns your style in 5 minutes.
step1_llm_subtitle: Agentys uses an LLM to draft your replies. Choose your provider.
step1_inbox_clean: Here is what we found. We can take care of it.
step1_no_scan: No scan data available. You can continue.
step1_error_session: Session expired. Reconnect your account and try again.
step1_error_account: Email account not configured. Reconnect your account.
step1_error_llm: LLM test failed. Check your API key.
step2_subtitle: Let's clean your inbox in one click. Newsletters will be deleted, old emails archived.
step2_processed: {{count}} emails processed in a few seconds.
step2_time_saved: That would have taken you about {{minutes}} minutes manually.
step3_subtitle: Agentys reads your recent emails in memory to reproduce your writing style.
step3_privacy_note: Content is processed from your provider during analysis. Agentys Cloud does not store email bodies or attachments; only the necessary profiles, rules and states are retained.
step3_ready_message: All set. Agentys will reply in your style.
step3_skip_hint: Training can be restarted later from Settings.
step3_stall_error: No progress detected. The server is not responding or the WebSocket connection is lost.
step4_subtitle: Your emails are now automatically sorted into 3 label categories.
step4_detected_subtitle: Based on the analysis of your emails
step4_project_labels_subtitle: Automatically group emails from the same project or work folder.
step4_project_added_preview: Emails about "{{name}}" will be grouped here
step4_vip_desc: Emails from your important contacts will always be prioritized
step4_vip_suggestions_hint: People you email most — click to add as VIP
step5_subtitle: Choose an email and send your first AI reply.
step5_comparison: Average: 5 minutes per email. You just did that in {{seconds}} seconds.
step5_no_drafts: No pending emails. Your AI is ready!
step5_select_hint: Select an email to see the AI draft
final_ready_subtitle_v2: Your email assistant is configured and ready to help.
final_subheadline: Here is what you accomplished in a few minutes.
final_savings_title: At this rate, you will save:

progress_style_desc: Extracting communication patterns and tone per contact.
progress_label_desc: Creating automatic sorting rules based on your projects.
progress_error_desc: An error occurred during the analysis of your emails.
progress_subtitle: Agentys temporarily analyzes your emails to understand your communication style.
progress_cancel_hint: Cancellation will occur between two batches — partial results will be preserved.
insights_subtitle: Agentys analyzed {{count}} emails and generated your communication profile.

wizard_llm_claude_desc: State-of-the-art AI, ideal for professional emails
wizard_llm_claude_code_desc: Uses your Claude Code subscription, no API key needed
wizard_mode_desc: Choose how the AI assistant should handle your replies.
wizard_mode_magic_desc: Drafts are automatically created in your email client
wizard_mode_controlled_desc: Preview and validate each reply before sending
wizard_mode_controlled_d1: Preview in app before draft creation
wizard_mode_manual_desc: No action without your explicit approval
tour_sidebar_desc: Navigate between your folders: inbox, AI drafts, sent, archives and trash.
tour_drafts_desc: Find all drafts generated by Agentys here. Validate, edit or reject them.
tour_shortcuts_desc: J/K to navigate, Enter to open, D for Sprint mode. Save time!
tour_focus_desc: Activate focus mode to process your emails without distraction.

step3_autolabel_intro: Your emails are now automatically sorted
step3_autolabel_action_desc: Emails requiring a response or action from you
step3_autolabel_fyi_desc: Emails for your information, no response expected
faq_source_desc: Import your frequently asked questions from a website or document. Agentys will answer them automatically.
faq_url_desc: Paste your FAQ page URL. Agentys will automatically detect questions and answers.

faq_no_results: No FAQ detected on this page.

faq_import_success_desc: {{count}} FAQ entries saved to your knowledge base.

scan_phase_knowledge: Extracting contacts, projects and key terms

discovery_addressing_mixed: Mixed addressing depending on the contact
v2_welcome_desc:
See how Agentys turns a few words into a full email.
Only one shortcut to remember.
v2_bar_desc: Click the pill or press the shortcut on your keyboard.
v2_bar_desc_2: For the next step, press N.
v2_reading_desc: Take a moment to read it. See what a few keywords became.
v2_compose_desc: Keywords are enough. AI writes the rest.
v2_compose_hint: Then press Ctrl+G to finish with AI.
v2_compose_alt: Or write the full email and AI polishes it.
v2_celebrate_desc: You just wrote a polished email from a few words. That's the whole idea of Agentys.
v2_demo_body: hi team, confirm meeting tuesday 3pm, suggest coffee, best
v2_label_sorting: Agentys is sorting your emails into three categories:
v2_label_desc: If an email lands in the wrong category, right-click it to choose the correct label.
v2_label_desc_2: Each correction trains Agentys to auto-sort better next time.
step3_retry_connect_aria: Connect my email to continue onboarding
skip_confirm_desc: Without training, your AI will reply with a generic style — it won't learn your tone, signatures, or contacts.
skip_confirm_hint: You can still run training later from Settings.
cancel_confirm_desc: The current analysis will be interrupted. Any partial results already computed will be kept.
insights_empty_desc: We couldn't extract enough data from your mailbox. Send a few emails and rerun training from Settings.
scan_partial_no_sent: No sent emails were found: we couldn't learn your style. Send a few emails and rerun training from Settings.
scan_partial_unsupported_language: The detected language ({{language}}) is not yet supported. The analysis was run in English: suggestion quality will be reduced until a dedicated prompt variant is added.
scan_partial_sent_fetch_failed: We couldn't fetch your sent emails — your provider (Gmail/Outlook) may be rate-limiting our requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.
insights_profession_placeholder: e.g. real estate broker, lawyer, SaaS founder
insights_profession_save_error: Unable to save your profession. Please try again.
step4_partial_create: Some labels couldn't be created — you can retry from Settings
followups_subtitle: Agentys can quietly prepare a follow-up when someone doesn't reply — so nothing slips through.
followups_card_desc: After you send an email, if no reply comes in a few days, Agentys prepares a polite follow-up draft (🔁) you can send in one click.
followups_enabled_confirm: Smart follow-ups are on. You'll see a 🔁 draft when a reply is overdue.
followups_unavailable: Follow-up rules will be available in Settings → Quick Steps.
followups_error: Couldn't update follow-ups. Please try again.
v2_mobile_bar_desc: Keyboard shortcuts are replaced with touch actions that fit the screen.
v2_mobile_bar_desc_2: Tap the button below to open the composer with a ready example.
v2_mobile_compose_hint: On mobile, tap the AI button in the composer to turn your notes into a complete email.
